trust_decision.summary: Whether a client holding the API token (token is handed to anyone who loads the UI HTML) may write files, delete files, run tests, or touch files outside Vite server.fs.allow is decided per WebSocket handler in packages/vitest/src/api/setup.ts (UI API) and packages/browser/src/node/rpc.ts + commands/fs.ts (browser API); at the pinned commit there is no write/exec gate at all, and the file check is the deprecated isFileServingAllowed that returns true when server.fs.strict is false.

landing_point.why: The summary names the Vitest UI server and file read/execute; the UI WebSocket handlers saveTestFile/rerun/rerunTask are the obvious write+exec sinks reachable from the UI.
